We're a small, focused team of operators who build and run real growth systems for B2B companies. No fluff, no layers — just impact.

Why operators choose WeFlair

What working here actually looks like

Real operator work

You'll own systems end to end — paid media, outbound, RevOps, CRO. No one here is "just advising." You're in the CRM, in the ad account, in the data.

Remote-first, always

Work from anywhere. We're distributed across time zones and async by default. What matters is output, not office hours.

Outcome-driven comp

Your comp reflects the results you generate. We tie meaningful upside to pipeline created, deals influenced, and systems scaled.

Zero bureaucracy

No status meetings about status meetings. No 47-slide decks. Small team, direct access to clients, fast decisions.

Open roles

No open roles right now — but we're always interested in hearing from sharp operators.
